# LWN.net

> LWN.net is the premier source for Linux kernel development news, security coverage, and free software analysis.

Founded by Eklektix, Inc. and edited by Jonathan Corbet, LWN.net provides in-depth weekly coverage of Linux kernel changes, security vulnerabilities, and open-source community developments. The site maintains extensive archives, a kernel patch database, and community event calendars.

## Key Topics

- Linux kernel
- BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter)
- io_uring
- kernel development
- security vulnerabilities
- free software
- open-source
- kernel patches
- community governance
- Linux distributions
- asynchronous I/O
- development tools
- weekly editions
- security articles

## Core Resources

- [Welcome to LWN.net](https://lwn.net): LWN.net homepage covering Linux news, kernel development, and free software
- [LWN.net Subscriptions](https://lwn.net/subscribe): Subscription pricing and account management for LWN services
- [Subscription Information](https://lwn.net/subscribe/Info): Subscription information, registration, and payment plans

## Kernel & Technical Coverage

- [Kernel Coverage at LWN.net](https://lwn.net/Kernel): Linux kernel coverage index with BPF, io_uring, and patch database
- [BPF Meets io_uring](https://lwn.net/Articles/847951): Article on BPF and io_uring kernel subsystems and asynchronous I/O
- [BPF Controlled io_uring Patch Discussion](https://lwn.net/ml/all/cover.1772109579.git.asml.silence@gmail.com): Kernel patch discussion on BPF-controlled io_uring by Pavel Begunkov

## Security & Community

- [LWN Security Resources](https://lwn.net/Security): Security resources, vulnerability database, and Linux security articles
- [The LWN.net Community Calendar](https://lwn.net/Calendar): Linux community events calendar with conference listings and CFP deadlines

## Reference & Support

- [The LWN.net FAQ](https://lwn.net/op/FAQ.lwn): FAQ covering subscriptions, site guide, and contact information
- [Writing for LWN](https://lwn.net/op/AuthorGuide.lwn): Guide for contributing articles and freelance writing to LWN

## Optional

- [LWN.net Weekly Edition Archives](https://lwn.net/Archives): Archive index of LWN weekly editions, kernel updates, and security articles
